summary: This document describes an optional IPv6 destination option that carries sequence numbers and timing information in each packet. The measurements can be examined in real time or later, and help diagnose where delays and performance problems are happening.

eli5.summary: It is like stamping each package with a number and a time, so you can see where in the delivery trip it got slow.

how to measure ipv6 packet delay
